THE SPACE CRAFT APPROACH

Less guesswork.
More common ground.

An office project has many moving parts. Keep people, design and delivery connected from the beginning.

Let’s talk about your space ↗
01
UNDERSTAND

Start with people, plans and constraints.

Share the floor plan, headcount, working patterns and priorities. Clarify who makes decisions, what budget is available and which dates are fixed.

The useful outcomeA shared brief and a list of open questions.
02
SHAPE

Explore the right possibilities.

Compare layouts and a visual direction. Think through focus, collaboration, storage, visitors and the practical condition of the existing space.

The useful outcomeA direction to develop, with assumptions recorded.
03
RESOLVE

Bring scope and detail together.

Review material samples, furniture, lighting and building services with the appropriate specialists. Confirm scope, dependencies and change decisions.

The useful outcomeA clearer basis for pricing, coordination and delivery.
04
CREATE

Turn decisions into a working space.

Coordinate the agreed work, review progress and keep decisions visible. Discuss walkthroughs, handover information and any final items before moving in.

The useful outcomeA reviewed space and an agreed handover checklist.
